text: dsh-ui-tool-graph 是面向 DSH Web 对话页的工具调用分析插件，在会话视图中加入工具图谱面板。它从会话事件整理工具调用和模型用量，在浏览器端汇总各工具的调用次数、运行状态、失败数、耗时与 token 数据，并按调用顺序统计工具转移。用户可以按耗时、次数或错误重新加权图中节点，查看瓶颈、错误率、重复调用和长间隔等规则提示，也能打开单工具调用明细。面板还生成包含统计表和分析角度的下一轮优化提示，支持复制或经二次确认后排入当前会话。适合复盘工具密集型会话；代码未要求额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ui-tool-graph adds a tool-analysis panel to DSH Web. It summarizes calls, errors, duration, transitions, and tokens. Compare tools by duration, calls, or errors; inspect findings and call details; copy or queue an optimization prompt. No API key or external service is declared.

dsh-ui-tool-graph 的功能「工具调用图谱」：在对话面板按耗时、调用数或错误数排列工具节点，并用连线呈现同一轮中的连续工具转移。
dsh-ui-tool-graph 的功能「会话指标与洞察」：汇总调用、失败、耗时和 token，并提示耗时瓶颈、错误工具、重复调用及长间隔；可查看工具排名和单次调用。
dsh-ui-tool-graph 的功能「下一轮优化提示」：把当前会话指标、工具排名、转移和规则发现整理成分析提示，可复制到剪贴板，或二次点击后排入会话。

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · dsh-ui-tool-graph：A **tool-call value graph** tab for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) Web UI.

Agent trajectories bury their own economics: which tool ate the wall time, where calls failed, how many tokens each round burned, which calls repeated themselves verbatim. This plugin adds a **Tool Graph (工具图谱)** tab to the conversation view ring that folds the session log into one weighted relationship graph:
dsh-ui-tool-graph README · dsh-ui-tool-graph：Everything is folded client-side from the durable session log — deterministic, replay-safe, no extra model calls, no persistence, zero token cost.

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · Features：- **Weighted radial graph** — switch node weighting between total duration / call count / errors at any time; edge width ∝ transition count.
- **Optimization insights** — rule-derived findings with severity dots: bottleneck share, error-prone tools, verbatim repeats (cache/dedup candidates), consecutive same-tool chains, model-generation waits, token-heavy steps.
- **Per-tool ranking table** — total / average duration, calls, errors; click a row or node to drill into every individual call with its duration and argument excerpt.
- **Session totals strip** — calls, running, failures, tool wall time, longest average gap, output tokens.
- **One-click next turn** — copy the analysis prompt, or send it as your next queued message after an explicit second click.

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · Installation：This checkout targets Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and Cordis `4.0.4`. Place the repositories at `ai/deepseek-harness` and `ai/dsh-plugins/dsh-ui-tool-graph`, and build Harness first; development dependencies link to its built libraries. Build this package, then install its tarball.

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

Restart the profile if the Plugin Manager reports that a restart is required. Every conversation gains a **工具图谱 (Tool Graph)** tab.

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · Installation：For Desktop, install the generated tarball through **Plugins** in the running application, enable the bundle, and restart Desktop when requested. Open a conversation and select **Tool Graph (工具图谱)**. A conversation without tool calls displays an empty state. The CLI commands here manage a Web profile, not Desktop's reserved profile.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ui-tool-graph`.

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · How it works：| Metric | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Call duration | `tool/result` time − paired `tool/call` time (wall clock) |
| Tool wall time | Sum over completed calls in the loaded window |
| Error rate | Error results ÷ completed calls per tool |
| Transition edge | Consecutive call pair within one turn, in log order |
| Average gap | Per-edge mean of result→next-start latency (dominated by model generation wait) |
| Tokens | Provider usage carried by each finalized assistant message, deduplicated per step |

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · How it works：The view target folds incrementally (`replace`/`apply` over the event window), so totals cover exactly what the history window holds; page older turns in the Trajectory tab to extend coverage. Result-only records without their loaded call are excluded because the name and start time are unavailable. The plugin registers event definitions and its view through `uiConversation` and receives its per-session target through the framework-bound `useToolGraph` hook. Colors follow the application's light and dark theme tokens.

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · Known limitations：- Nested sub-calls (delegations) fold as their parent result only.
- The LLM-vs-tool wall-time split is approximated by inter-call gaps; per-request timing attribution is not yet surfaced.
- Single-tool sessions render one node without edges — by definition.

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit (strict)
pnpm test        # vitest: folding parity, layout purity, prompts, component behavior
pnpm build       # lib/index.js (node half) + lib/client.js (browser bundle)

dsh-ui-tool-graph README · Development：The package is a dual-identity bundle: `dsh.bundle` ships the patch layer, `dsh.client` declares the web plugin. Runtime imports are limited to the host-shared React, Cordis, Client Store, UI Slots, UI Primitives, and Dockkit modules; feature plugins are accessed through type declarations and injected services.
